{{Quote|Royal Marine Regiment sounds like it might be for me.|A spacer, to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Typho]]|<ref name="SWG:TSI" />}}
The '''Royal Marine Regiment''', abbreviated '''RMR''', was an elite military unit of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]].<ref name="SWG:TSI" />

==History==
{{Quote|I'd like to do Marine work.|A spacer, to Captain Typho|<ref name="SWG:TSE" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Royal Marine Regiment [[Royal Security Forces marines raid on Mauler base|raided]] the [[Maulers|Mauler]] [[Mauler Stronghold|base]] near the city of [[Keren/Legends|Keren]].<ref name="SWG:TSI" /> The Mauler chief tactician [[Zolo Sartain]], the [[Chief of Security/Legends|chief of security]] [[Yarick Tempol]], the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Xylan Kee'choap]] and the mystic [[Walus Mutin]] were eliminated during the operation.<ref name="SWG:TSE">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Typho - Stronghold Elimination|Naboo}}</ref>
